canonical_statement: For every nonempty finite family of bounded analytic complex functions on the open unit disc and every positive real delta that bounds their pointwise sum of norms below, there is a bounded analytic coefficient family whose pointwise Bezout combination is one.
domain_and_universes: Prop in universe 0; ι : Type with Fintype and Nonempty instances; ambient functions ℂ -> ℂ; δ : ℝ; z ranges over Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1.
hypotheses: each f_i is AnalyticOnNhd ℂ on Metric.ball 0 1 and its image of that set is Bornology.IsBounded
for every z in Metric.ball 0 1, δ <= Finset.univ.sum (fun i => norm (f i z))
conclusion: There is g : ι -> ℂ -> ℂ such that each g_i satisfies the same H-infinity predicate and, for every z in the open unit disc, Finset.univ.sum (fun i => f i z * g i z) = 1.
